Clafer with super clafer.description: Clafer inheriting from a super clafer

Group cardinality.description: Clafer with group cardinality and two children

Quantified expression.description: Quantified expression over a declared variable

Universal quantification over distinct p.description: Quantification over pairs of distinct elements

State machine.description: Alternative states with transitions; the instances of a temporal model are traces (Clafer 0.5.6, Alloy)

Transition.description: Transition: --> to the next step, -->> a lasts until b

Guarded transition.description: Transition that fires only when the guard holds

Temporal clafer.description: Clafer that is present in the first state (initial), or does not change during a trace (final, finalref, finaltarget)

Initial constraint.description: Constraint on the first state; other constraints hold in every state

Scenario.description: A sequence of states from the start of the trace

Next state.description: If a holds, then b holds in the next state

Temporal pattern.description: Dwyer's pattern: what must hold in a trace; can end with before p, after p or between p and q

Order pattern.description: Dwyer's pattern: response (b must follow a) or precedence (b must precede a)

OPTIONS directive.description: Compiler options; recognized only on the first line of the file

OPTIONS directive with integer range.description: Integer range of the Choco output (Clafer 0.5.3); recognized only on the first line of the file

OPTIONS directive with decimal digits.description: Fractional digits of the decimals in the Choco output (Clafer 0.5.5); by default, the most fractional digits of the literals; recognized only on the first line of the file

FRAGMENT directive.description: Start of a new module fragment; must be alone on its line

SUMMARY directive.description: Insertion point for graph and statistics (HTML mode); must be alone on its line
